responsibility: This file provides H8/300 bit-field and single-bit extraction/insertion patterns, especially for H8SX bit manipulation instructions such as bld, bst, bild, bfst and related zero_extract/insv/extzv forms. It is responsible for recognizing RTL that loads, inverts, inserts, or stores bit slices in registers and selected memory operands, forcing suitable addressing/register forms when needed, and lowering those operations either directly to specialized bitfield instructions or to split post-reload CC-clobbering sequences distinct from the more general logical and compare files.
